Package ss.week2.camera

Class SpeedCamera

java.lang.Object
ss.week2.camera.SpeedCamera
public class SpeedCamera extends Object
A speed camera that records the speeds of passing cars, in km/h. It remembers all measurements, oldest first, and computes statistics and fines. There is no maximum number of measurements.
